name: aloe barbadensis leaf + camellia sinensis seed oil
purpose: 1. Contains tea tree oil, which can eradicate fungi and relieve foot fungal problems. 2. Use in multiple scenarios, can be used on feet, socks and shoes. 3. It can strengthen and protect the skin for a long time and prevent reinfection. 4. It uses mild ingredients and will not cause damage to the skin.
uses: 1. Completely clean and dry foot skin 2. Take an appropriate amount of this product and spray it on your feet, shoes or socks 3. Wait 2-3 minutes for your feet to fully absorb it.
